description:
Duplicate the existing 'Brown v. Board of Education' (1954) case in your library and modify the duplicate to create the 1955 implementation decree ('Brown II'). 

1. Locate 'Brown v. Board of Education' (347 U.S. 483, 1954).
2. Duplicate the item.
3. Modify the DUPLICATE to have:
   - Case Name: 'Brown v. Board of Education II'
   - Volume: '349'
   - First Page: '294'
   - Date Decided: '1955'
   - Abstract: 'Implementation decree requiring desegregation of public schools with all deliberate speed, following the 1954 decision declaring segregation unconstitutional.'

Ensure the original 1954 case remains unchanged.

metadata.new_case_name: Brown v. Board of Education II
